exposure: Patients with and without placenta previa
cohort: 514 patients undergoing their third or more Cesarean delivery
finding: In patients undergoing a third or more Cesarean delivery, only placenta previa, prophylactic anticoagulation during pregnancy, and labor were independently associated with requiring a blood transfusion.
mod_finding: This study found that in patients undergoing a third or more Cesarean delivery, only placenta previa, prophylactic anticoagulation during pregnancy, and having labored are independently associated with requiring a blood transfusion.
